test.create_query: CREATE TABLE key_path_fact (a UInt32, k UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE key_path_dim_a (a UInt32, name String, label String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY a
CREATE TABLE key_path_dim_k (k UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO key_path_fact SELECT if(number % 10 != 0, number % 3, 100 + intHash32(number) % 1000000), intHash32(number * 7) % 3000 FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO key_path_dim_a SELECT number, if(number < 3, 'hot', toString(number % 300000)), concat('label_', hex(intHash64(number))) FROM numbers(1000100)
INSERT INTO key_path_dim_k SELECT number FROM numbers(30)
test.query: SELECT key_path_dim_a.label, count() FROM key_path_fact JOIN key_path_dim_a ON key_path_fact.a = key_path_dim_a.a JOIN key_path_dim_k ON key_path_fact.k = key_path_dim_k.k WHERE key_path_dim_a.name = 'hot' GROUP BY key_path_dim_a.label
